name: Aripiprazole
dosing: Schizophrenia: 10-15mg OD (max 30mg). Bipolar: 15-30mg OD. Depot: 400mg monthly IM
contraindications: Hypersensitivity, caution in cardiovascular disease, epilepsy
interactions: CYP3A4/2D6 inhibitors (↑ levels), carbamazepine (↓ levels), antihypertensives
monitoring: Weight, glucose, lipids, ECG (baseline), prolactin, movement disorders
pregnancy: Avoid unless essential - neonatal extrapyramidal effects reported
sideEffects: Akathisia, insomnia, anxiety, weight gain (less than other atypicals), dyslipidaemia
pharmacokinetics: Long half-life (75h), hepatic metabolism, active metabolite
clinicalPearls: Lower weight gain/metabolic risk than olanzapine. Akathisia common - may need propranolol
indication: Schizophrenia, bipolar disorder (mania/mixed episodes), adjunct in treatment-resistant depression
